steps.prompt:
`bmb check` does not report the diagnostic E0501 yet: a contract clause with a quantifier must be a call to a named predicate (`spec fn ... -> bool`); one without is an expression (ADR-0095 A2). It came with the commit "compiler: M1 front end (parse, check, JSONL diagnostics)". Implement it. Examples of what `bmb check` must print (one JSON line per diagnostic; the path in `file` is the one given on the command line), each after the source line it points at:

    ensures forall |i: usize| i < a.len() ==> #[trigger] a[i] == a[i],
    {"code": "E0501", "severity": "error", "message": "a contract clause with a quantifier is not a named predicate", "file": "err/proofs.bmb", "line": 67, "col": 17, "end_line": 67, "end_col": 74, "fix": {"message": "move the quantified condition into `spec fn name(..) -> bool { .. }` and call it here"}}

Everything else the program prints must stay as it is.

`bmb check` does not report the diagnostic E0255 yet: more than one `#[invariant(..)]` on a type: join the conditions with `&&` in one predicate. It came with the commit "T1-11: type invariants (ADR-0060 tasks 1-5)". Implement it. Examples of what `bmb check` must print (one JSON line per diagnostic; the path in `file` is the one given on the command line), each after the source line it points at:

    #[invariant(small_k)]
    {"code": "E0255", "severity": "error", "message": "`K` has more than one `#[invariant(..)]`", "file": "err/invariants.bmb", "line": 82, "col": 5, "end_line": 82, "end_col": 26, "fix": {"message": "state every condition in one predicate joined with `&&`, and keep one attribute"}}

Everything else the program prints must stay as it is.
